architecture.scope: Twelve near-road houses around Sinna map3900–4070m, selected from established review cameras01–03
architecture.geometry_policy: Original objects/meshes/transforms/UVs/normals and polygon material indices unchanged; explicit private material rebindings only
architecture.accuracy: OSM envelopes retained; house treatments/canopies/cladding are regional reconstruction, not address-matched photographs
limitations: Native Blender materials require deliberate baking/conversion for AC
Original openings and house silhouettes remain; gable board finish is an overlay inside existing roof envelope
Canopy/architrave additions are inferred, not actual surveyed facade details

limits: Regional artist reconstruction, no exact species or parcel photographs claimed.
Frontage art only, no new background trees or full-track upgrade.
New alpha and foliage materials are native Blender source; AC shader translation, LOD and FPS unverified.
